pages.text: Home > About About Herron Engineering was established by William Herron in 1989 and it was incorporated as Herron Engineering Ltd. in 2005. The company is based in County Down, Northern Ireland. Herron Engineering offer a wide range of agricultural / industrial trailers and slurry tankers with options to suit the individual needs. Our range includes grain and silage trailers , flat bed and bale trailers , dropside basic and heavy duty tipping trailers , front loaders , dump trailers , agricultural and industrial low loaders , slurry tankers , trailing shoes and dribble bars . We can deliver bespoke products manufactured to customer specifications. All our products are designed, plasma cut, folded, welded and fitted in-house, using the highest quality materials, latest technology and skilled workforce. Before our machinery is painted with high quality polyurethane two-pack paint, it is shot-blasted in our newly purpose built facility. This process facilitates the formation of a permanent bond between the paint and shot-blasted surface to give all our products a long-lasting superior finish. Quality and innovation have been at our focus since 1989 and this approach continues to date. We always strive to provide the robust, practical and efficient solutions to meet the needs of the demanding market today and ensure our customers satisfaction. If you are interested in our products or would like information about career prospects within our company, please do not hesitate to contact one of our team members. You can reach us by telephone, e-mail or simply fill in the form on our contact page .
